description: This file defines the Xss class in the Drupal namespace, providing methods for filtering HTML to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities. It includes lists of allowed HTML tags for different filtering contexts and methods for sanitizing HTML input.

classes.name: Xss
classes.description: A utility class for filtering HTML to prevent XSS vulnerabilities, with methods for sanitization and allowed tags management.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML input to prevent XSS, allowing only specified tags.

methods.name: filterAdmin
methods.description: Permissive filter allowing all admin tags, excluding scripts and styles.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Processes an individual HTML tag, allowing only permitted tags and attributes.

methods.name: attributes
methods.description: Parses and sanitizes HTML tag attributes.

methods.name: needsRemoval
methods.description: Determines if an HTML element should be removed based on allowed tags.

methods.name: getAdminTagList
methods.description: Returns the list of HTML tags allowed in admin filter.

methods.name: getHtmlTagList
methods.description: Returns the default list of allowed HTML tags.
